create_Waymo_dataset: create a Waymo dataset instance with a ROOT path and resolution for loading preprocessed Waymo stereo pairs
load_Waymo_pairs: load preprocessed Waymo image pairs from waymo_pairs.npz including scenes, frames, and pair indices
get_Waymo_views: get stereo view pairs with images, depthmaps, camera poses, and intrinsics for a given pair index
get_Waymo_stats: get statistics string showing total pairs and scenes count from the Waymo dataset
review_Waymo_class: review the Waymo class inheriting BaseStereoViewDataset for loading and serving preprocessed Waymo outdoor street scene stereo pairs
